# ChartMogul

A subscription intelligence platform selling revenue analytics, billing data modeling, and customer retention tools to SaaS companies.

**Route:** surfaced by the SaaS Billing Integration lane's de-branded queries → judged untiered → integration to clerk.com.

**Why it's on the map:** It acts as a data intelligence layer that monitors the subscription and billing activity generated by SaaS platforms, including those built with the anchor's authentication infrastructure.

**Receipts** (verbatim from its page this run):

> The AI-native stack for subscription intelligence

> turning every payment, refund, upgrade, discount, and currency fluctuation into accurate revenue metrics

> Bring billing, communication, lead, and product usage data together in ChartMogul.
